segments.name: Digital Data and Analytics
segments.description: Provider of digital data and analytics enabling businesses to make data-driven decisions across digital channels worldwide.
segments.evidence: Similarweb is a leading provider of digital data and analytics that power critical business decisions.

revenueModel.text: Businesses pay subscription fees for productized software solutions, data feeds, APIs, and advisory services to access digital data and analytics.
revenueModel.evidence: Businesses utilize our productized SaaS solutions to enhance the capabilities of their professionals at all levels of the organization- from business leaders, strategy teams, analysts, marketers, and category managers to salespeople - to quickly and efficiently discover their best growth opportunities, identify potential competitive threats and make critical decisions to acquire customers and grow revenue.
